metadata.title: Renewable generation and planning benchmarks
metadata.warning: Technology costs and capacity factors are benchmarks, not Botswana project quotes or measured plant performance.

ireNA_2024_global.source: IRENA Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2024

botswana_resource_screening.solar_pvout_note: Country-average screening value reported in published analysis using Global Solar Atlas. Site-specific decisions should use Global Solar Atlas raster/NASA POWER, not this national average.
botswana_resource_screening.wind_note: Wind speed distribution supports resource screening only. GridIQ uses IRENA's global average capacity factor only when benchmark wind mode is explicitly enabled.

finance_screening.note: User-adjustable screening assumption used only to annualize benchmark capital costs. It is not a Botswana regulated WACC.
